title: QUIC RFC 9000 Peer Connection-ID Lifecycle Runtime Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home execution, protected packet inspection for RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID emission, SpecTrace validation, and coverage-triage regeneration.
scope: This verification covers the bounded runtime peer connection-ID lifecycle seam: peer-issued connection-ID active set maintenance, increased Retire Prior To cleanup, protected RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID emission for retired lower sequences, local CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR handling for peer active-set excess, bounded pending retired-sequence tracking, continued acceptance of locally issued connection IDs until the peer retires them, and local issuance rejection/replenishment behavior when an additional issued ID would exceed or fit within the peer limit.
expected_result: Focused tests prove positive, negative, and edge coverage for local and peer active connection-ID limit handling, peer-issued connection-ID set maintenance, Retire Prior To retirement ordering, pending-retirement capacity, no-forget-before-retire state preservation, local route retention until peer retirement, and zero Retire Prior To replacement issuance. Nearby S19P15/S19P16 regression homes remain green so the existing frame-codec and RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID protocol-violation behavior is preserved.
procedure: Run the focused RFC 9000 peer connection-ID lifecycle requirement-home tests and nearby S19P15/S19P16 regression homes.
Run the focused S5P1P2 requirement-home test filter after the pending-retirement implementation and trace wiring.
Confirm protected RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID emission by opening the protected application-data packet and scanning the payload frames.
Render and check touched SpecTrace artifacts.
Regenerate the QUIC requirement coverage triage.
preconditions: The runtime has a validated active path and 1-RTT packet protection material.
The peer NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame is received on the protected application-data path.
The local active_connection_id_limit defaults to the RFC 9000 minimum when the test bootstrap transport parameters do not explicitly set it.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification intentionally does not claim S5P1P2-0001, S5P1P2-0002, S5P1P2-0006, or S5P1P2-0007 packet-association and address-pair discipline; full S9P5 migration discipline; preferred-address transition behavior; new local route registration beyond already issued local CIDs; public migration APIs; multipath behavior; or interop-runner migration success.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The focused S5P1P2 requirement-home filter passed 27/27 and the nearby S5P1P1/S5P1P2/S19P15/S19P16 regression filter passed 22/22, proving the bounded peer CID retirement pressure, pending-retirement cap, local route retention, no-forget-before-retire, and replacement issuance Retire Prior To seam while keeping packet-association/address-pair and broader migration clusters out of scope. Full no-build solution tests were attempted twice but hit unrelated transient S8/S10 socket/timeout failures that passed when rerun directly, so they are not counted as this verification's proof evidence.
